pitch_detail.notes: Well-maintained switchback trail through forest and alpine meadows. Gain 2,150 ft. 1.5-2 hours.
pitch_detail.pitch: Cathedral Rock Trailhead to Cathedral Pass (4.5 miles)

pitch_detail.notes: Alpine meadow traverse with some snow patches possible. Elevation 5,600 ft. 30-45 minutes.
pitch_detail.pitch: Cathedral Pass to Peggy's Pond (1 mile)

pitch_detail.notes: Braided cat-trails through alpine meadows, then scrambling over talus and scree. Faint climber's trail over rocky terrain. 1-1.5 hours.
pitch_detail.pitch: Peggy's Pond to Southeast Ridge saddle (2 miles)

pitch_detail.notes: Exposed scrambling with significant drop-offs. Loose, steep scree. Class 3 gendarmes and moves. 45 min-1 hour.
pitch_detail.pitch: Southeast Ridge saddle to East Summit (1 mile)

pitch_detail.notes: Descend from East Summit, enter Daniel Glacier, traverse west on moderate-angle glacier with potential crevasses. 45 min-1.5 hours depending on conditions.
pitch_detail.pitch: East Summit to Middle Summit via Daniel Glacier (1 mile)

pitch_detail.notes: Final scramble along ridge to highest summit (true Mount Daniel). Exposed but brief. 30-45 minutes.
pitch_detail.pitch: Middle Summit to West Summit (0.5 miles)
